events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Born in Manchester on September 21, 1972, William John Paul Gallagher is best known as the iconic lead singer of Oasis and later Beady Eye, before launching a successful solo career.

angles.name: Birthday shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger to the world. What's your favourite Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album is 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, becoming a worldwide number one and featuring his signature song.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. An album that continues to inspire and resonate across generations. What does the track mean to you?

events.title: Apple's first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket' and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Can you believe it's 25 years since the first iPod was unveiled? It changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who is your ultimate 007 and what's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Born in Liverpool on October 9, 1940, John Lennon was a founder of The Beatles, a prolific solo artist, and a peace activist.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate globally. What's the Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, a co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Birthday shout-out
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical styles.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that still sparks debate and discovery. What's your standout track?

events.title: 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the flamboyant lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing. His incredible voice and stage presence continue to captivate. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped. This album was a game-changer, pushing boundaries and influencing generations. What's your go-to track from it?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: On December 8, 1980, musician John Lennon was tragically shot and killed outside his New York City residence at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Today marks 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His legacy as a musician, songwriter, and advocate for peace continues to inspire. Share a memory or a favourite song.
